C1.label: Integer-valued functions (e.g., factorial, binomial coefficient, permutations, combinations, floor, ceiling)

D2.label: Solution of systems of linear equations (including inversion, LU and related decompositions)

D9.label: Singular, overdetermined or underdetermined systems of linear equations, generalized inverses

J1.label: Trigonometric transforms including fast Fourier transforms

K4.label: Other analytic approximations (e.g., Taylor polynomial, Pade)

L7.label: Analysis of variance (including analysis of covariance)

H2a1a1.label: Automatic (user need only specify required accuracy)

G2h3b1b.label: User provides first derivatives of function and constraints

I1a2.label: Stiff and mixed algebraic- differential equations

H2b1.label: One or more hyper-rectangular regions (includes iterated integrals)

H2c.label: Service routines (e.g., compute weights and nodes for quadrature formulas)

L10a.label: Univariate (search also classes L3a6 and L3a7)

H2b1a1.label: Automatic (user need only specify required accuracy)

H2a2.label: Finite interval (specific or special type integrand including weight functions, oscillating and singular integrands, principal value integrals, splines, etc.)

G1a1c.label: User provides first and second derivatives

G1b1c.label: User provides first and second derivatives

H2a2a1.label: Automatic (user need only specify required accuracy)

D4b.label: Generalized eigenvalue problems (e.g., Ax = lambda Bx)

L5a1.label: Cumulative distribution functions, probability density functions

H2a3a1.label: Automatic (user need only specify required accuracy)

E3a.label: Evaluation of fitted functions, including quadrature

I2b1a1a.label: Rectangular domain (or topologically rectangular in the coordinate system)

L8b.label: Polynomial (e.g., y = b_0 + b_1x + b_2 x^2)

L5b1.label: Cumulative multivariate distribution functions, probability density functions

projects.name: fiats
projects.description: Neural-network inference using the GNU-compatible 0.12.0 source revision.

curation.gams_notes: Pinned Fiats tag 0.12.0 (upstream manifest version 0.11.1), named inference-engine at that revision, with an explicitly pinned compatible Julienne 1.3.1 dependency and Assert 1.7.0. projects.name: ftorch
projects.description: Call PyTorch models from Fortran; checked CPU inference with an embedded affine TorchScript model.

curation.gams_notes: The original FTorch Fortran and C++ sources are wrapped for FPM, using pinned Debian CPU LibTorch 2.6.0+dfsg-7, the C++20 mode, C++11 ABI and include/definition settings from the upstream CMake target. The operator C++ flag setting is restricted to a current, unshared source-package recipe; public requests cannot set it and previous cache keys are preserved. The self-contained consumer embeds a reproducibly generated 1,766-byte TorchScript model as hexadecimal text, writes tiny.pt in the sandbox and calls the author tensor/model API in REAL64. Two different five-element inputs exercise y=2*x+1, with each output checked independently for finiteness and absolute error below 1e-12. The second call also verifies that the input tensor observes updated Fortran storage. No Python or model download runs in visitor jobs. This is an illustrative affine inference model, not a trained scientific predictor. K covers inference as function approximation; no training or optimization classification is inferred. GPU use, training, autograd, parallel execution and arbitrary external models are not verified. FTorch MIT notices and native Debian dependency notices are retained. APT estimates about 924 MB of additional native dependencies in the isolated FTorch image; these are separate from the catalog logical library-artifact total.

projects.name: dbcsr
projects.description: Serial block-sparse matrix multiplication, checked against MATMUL.

curation.gams_notes: The upstream CMake-selected serial CPU library is rendered with Fypp 3.2, with exact generated-output hashes. Simple USE lists emitted from Python sets are sorted for reproducibility across Python versions and platforms; numerical algorithms are unchanged. MPI, OpenMP, GPU, LIBXS and LIBXSMM are disabled, and the library links pinned OpenBLAS. The diagnostic filename macro uses __FILE__. The checked main creates two 4-by-4 block-sparse matrices, multiplies them through dbcsr_multiply, reconstructs the result and independently compares it with MATMUL, requiring finite entries and a small maximum error. D1 covers matrix operations. Parallel scaling, accelerators and tensor operations are outside this verification scope. GPL-2.0-or-later notices are retained. The wrapper repeats the base-hooks USE list so FPM can order dependencies hidden in the original include. Its manifest permits legacy implicit external BLAS/LAPACK calls; runtime and bounds checks remain enabled.

procedures.notes: The existing catalog quadratic program is an independently written API example. Upstream licensing is unspecified; no upstream example code is copied here. Uses the actual kcount evaluation limit; optimizer termination status is not exposed by this wrapper. No upstream example code is copied. Other methods, nonsmooth/global optimization, scaling extremes and concurrent calls are not verified.

Fixed-iteration gradient descent with a user gradient. The dedicated independent driver checks 240 SPD-quadratic trajectories against spectral powers and exact callback counts. At this pin the returned objective belongs to the iterate before the final position update; the driver explicitly verifies this and recomputes the endpoint objective. convergence_tolerance is not used by this fixed-count implementation. projects.name: ddpcm

curation.gams_notes: The pinned ddCOSMO library and original fixed-form Lebedev quadrature source are wrapped for FPM with extension-based source form and legacy external interfaces. projects.name: fmm2d
projects.description: Fast multipole evaluation of two-dimensional Laplace and Helmholtz interactions.

curation.gams_notes: Native Fortran FMM2D source set selected from the upstream makefile with optional C++ fast kernels disabled. OpenMP and portable -O2 are enabled; the visitor sandbox uses one execution thread and retains bounds checks. Checksum-guarded compatibility edits skip zero-point multipole/local evaluations and zero-source neighbor calls before passing one-past-end array elements. The inverse reorder helper declares its arrays with the actual n extent rather than the legacy dummy extent 1. Source and target branches receive matching guards; formulas are unchanged. The checked real Laplace driver evaluates 512 deterministic sources at 16 separate targets and compares with an independent charge-weighted log-distance sum. A separate source-and-target probe also checks all source potentials by direct summation with self-interactions excluded, exercising the source-side guards. The code is classified as a structured kernel-matrix application and Green-function evaluation related to PDEs, not as a complete boundary-value solver. Helmholtz, biharmonic/Stokes, dipoles, gradients/Hessians, every complex/vector interface and parallel speedups are not validated. The small accuracy check is not a performance benchmark.

325 REAL64 adjacent-difference calls on lengths 0..24, orders 0..6, plain and (for positive orders) with prepend/append arrays. 432 REAL64 Kronecker products over 144 rectangular shape pairs and three sign/zero families. 144 rank-one REAL64 vectors (lengths 1..12) and 24 rank-two 3x4 arrays normalized on both dimensions, including singletons and tied logits. For GELU=x*Phi(x), the derivative is Phi(x)+x*phi(x); the implementation uses x/sqrt(2) instead of x/sqrt(2*pi) for the exponential term. INT64 greatest common divisors for all signed pairs -40..40, using exhaustive common-divisor enumeration rather than Euclid; zero-zero convention and four large exact cases. Minimum representable integers and overflow are not tested.

60 REAL64 logarithmic grids, four positive bases (2,4,10,0.5), ascending/descending/constant exponents and lengths 1,2,3,8,17; 372 stored 80/120-digit independent references. Empty/negative lengths and default length/base also checked. No complex bases or negative-base domains claimed.

867 REAL64 dyadic ranges checked by independent repeated addition including descending endpoints and a final partial step. The upper endpoint is included when reached; step magnitude is directed toward the end. Also checks 17 single-argument INT64 ranges. Zero/negative explicit steps and large allocations are excluded.

REAL64 Cartesian grids for all 42 rectangular sizes nx=1..7, ny=1..6, both default xy and explicit ij layouts, using coordinate lookup references. Coordinates and inputs are exact dyadics; no rank-three/four or invalid shape behavior claimed.

REAL64 elemental clipping over 129 dyadic values and 15 valid bound pairs, including equal bounds; independent branch references and vector/scalar checks. Also checks INT64 clipping at 10^12 scale. Reversed bounds and nonfinite values excluded.

289 exact rational truth-table pairs with explicit dyadic relative/absolute tolerances, symmetry, scalar and elemental REAL64 comparisons, plus rank-two REAL64/COMPLEX128 all_close and explicit NaN policy. Complex comparison is componentwise; infinities and implicit default tolerances excluded.

COMPLEX128 phase in radians, degrees and multiples of pi for eight exact axis/diagonal directions at 25 powers-of-two scales; known quadrant fractions of an independently stored pi constant. Origin, signed-zero branch cuts, nonfinite values and general off-diagonal angles excluded.

REAL64 degree/radian conversion for 145 values -1080..1080 by 15 degrees, checked independently in both directions against a stored 80/120-digit pi constant. Round trips are secondary, not the oracle. No huge-angle reduction or trigonometric accuracy claimed. Classified broadly as service routines, not an inverse-trigonometric solver.

Elemental exchange for disjoint REAL64, COMPLEX128 and INT64 vectors of lengths 0..64, checked against saved inputs after one and two exchanges. Also checks disjoint strided slices. Aliasing, character/string and derived-type overloads excluded.

REAL64, COMPLEX128 and INT64 traces for 90 rectangular shapes including empty dimensions; closed-form diagonal sums from entry formulas, plus exact input preservation. Rectangular trace means the sum through min(m,n). Integer overflow and arbitrary kinds excluded.

90 rectangular identities with REAL64 default, COMPLEX128 and INT64 mold selection, including empty shapes; entrywise Kronecker-delta references. Ten default square shapes also checked. Negative dimensions excluded.

REAL64 and COMPLEX128 conjugate transpose over 90 rectangular shapes including empty dimensions; independent entry formulas, reversed shapes, exact input preservation and secondary involution. Integer and other overloads excluded.

procedures.procedure: is_square, is_diagonal, is_symmetric, is_skew_symmetric, is_hermitian, is_triangular, is_hessenberg
procedures.notes: Seven exact matrix predicates: 204 one-hot positions in square sizes 1..8 with real/complex input; zero matrices, real symmetric/skew pairs and genuinely complex Hermitian pairs; triangular/Hessenberg orientations and 42 rectangular squareness checks. No tolerance, nonfinite or invalid-selector behavior claimed.

REAL64/COMPLEX128 vector norms for the exact 3-4-12 triple with zero (L1=19,L2=13,Linf=12,min=0), 17 dyadic scales, and complex coordinate phases. Rank-two arrays have three scaled columns, known aggregate norms and explicit dimension reductions. Only orders 1,2,inf,-inf; no empty or extreme-scale inputs claimed.

REAL64 pivoted LU with preallocated solution/pivots: sizes 1..10, three dyadic scales, vector and three-column RHS, both preservation and overwrite_a modes (120 calls). Row-reversed diagonally dominant matrices force pivoting for n>1. Known manufactured solutions, residuals and pivot ranges; singular/error cases excluded.

COMPLEX128 positive-definite matrices manufactured as L*L^H from explicit positive-real-diagonal triangular factors: sizes 1..8, three entry patterns and three scales (72 matrices; 144 lower/upper calls). Compare unique factors, zero unused triangles, reconstruction and input preservation. No indefinite/error cases or extreme conditioning claimed.

COMPLEX128 Hermitian spectra built with independently checked Householder unitary matrices and prescribed distinct integer eigenvalues: sizes 2..9, four patterns, five scales, both lower/upper storage (320 solves). Eigenvalues, residuals, orthonormality, reconstruction and input preservation checked; no phase-specific eigenvector comparison, repeated eigenvalues or generalized problem claimed.

COMPLEX128 thin SVD for 25 tall/square/wide sizes 2..6, full-rank and one-zero-singular-value spectra, three dyadic scales (150 cases). Independently checked unitary factors manufacture known singular values; reconstruction and both unitary Gram matrices verified without choosing singular-vector phases. No ill-conditioned rank cutoff or full-matrix API claim.

COMPLEX128 full-column-rank overdetermined least squares: n=1..5, m=n+2..n+4, three unitary patterns (45 cases). Known coefficients and nonzero residual in an explicitly checked orthogonal complement; recovered coefficients, rank, residual and A^H*r stationarity checked. Inputs preserved; no rank-deficient or underdetermined/minimum-norm claim.

72 COMPLEX128 determinants: sizes 1..8, three spectral patterns and three scales; checked unitary similarity of prescribed nonzero complex diagonal entries followed by a cyclic row permutation. Independent product and permutation sign; input preservation. Singular matrices, overflow and extreme conditioning excluded.

72 COMPLEX128 inverses: sizes 1..8, three patterns and three scales. Checked unitary similarity gives independent reciprocal-diagonal inverse; both left/right identity residuals and exact input preservation. Singular and ill-conditioned matrices excluded.

150 COMPLEX128 pseudoinverses on 25 tall/square/wide shapes, full-rank and one-zero-singular-value spectra, three scales. Independent reciprocal nonzero singular values, all four Moore-Penrose identities and input preservation; explicit rtol=1e-12. Near-cutoff singular values, zero matrices and other tolerances excluded.

150 COMPLEX128 QR factorizations: 25 tall/square/wide shapes, three prescribed upper-trapezoidal patterns, full/reduced outputs. Checked unitary-times-triangular construction supplies diagonal magnitudes; reconstruction, orthonormal columns, triangular zeros and input preservation. No fixed phases, pivoted or rank-deficient QR claim.

63 COMPLEX128 Schur decompositions of nonnormal matrices: sizes 2..8, three triangular templates and three scales under checked unitary similarity. Independent diagonal eigenvalues matched one-to-one without ordering assumptions; Schur triangularity, unitary vectors, reconstruction and input preservation. Repeated/clustered eigenvalues and sorting excluded.

180 COMPLEX128 matrix exponentials: sizes 2..7, three nilpotent superdiagonal patterns, five scales, default and order-12 Pade. Independent finite Taylor polynomial for nilpotent N and scalar exp(lambda) for A=lambda*I+N; input preservation. Bounded nonnormal Jordan-type cases only, no general stability/performance claim.

144 COMPLEX128 general linear solves: sizes 1..8, three patterns, three scales, vector and three-column RHS. Row-reversed diagonally dominant non-Hermitian matrices with manufactured solutions; residuals and input preservation. Singular/ill-conditioned cases and overwrite mode excluded.

288 COMPLEX128 positive-definite solves: 72 known-factor matrices of sizes 1..8, three patterns/scales, vector and multiple RHS with lower/upper factorization. Manufactured coefficients, residuals and preservation. Both triangles populated; no indefinite or poisoned-unused-triangle behavior claimed.

45 COMPLEX128 weighted least-squares fits: n=1..5, m=n+2..n+4, three unitary patterns. Positive weights are exact squares 1,4,16; weighted design columns and a nonzero weighted residual are orthogonal by construction. Known coefficients, rank, weighted stationarity and input preservation checked. Extreme/zero weights and rank deficiency excluded.

72 COMPLEX128 equality-constrained fits: n=2..7, four unitary patterns, three diagonal scales. Independent diagonal-Hessian one-complex-equality KKT minimizer transformed by checked unitary coordinates; coefficients, feasibility, stationarity and all input preservation. Only one full-row-rank equality and full-column-rank cost; inequalities and deficient ranks excluded.

64 COMPLEX128 three-variable data selections (32 datasets, all/row masks), exact Fraction means; rank-one, rank-two whole-array and dimension-1/2 masked reductions, plus unmasked reductions. No empty/all-false masks, missing values or high-rank arrays claimed.

64 COMPLEX128 data selections, population/sample variance with REAL64 nonnegative results. Exact pairwise squared-distance references; scalar masked and dimension-1/2 reductions. This is E(abs(Z-mean)**2), not the analytic second central power. Empty/singleton and nonfinite cases excluded.

64 COMPLEX128 three-variable selections, both population/sample corrections and masked/unmasked paths. Exact pairwise-difference covariance oracle. Column observations dim=1 conjugate the first variable; transpose to row observations dim=2 gives the conjugate covariance matrix. Only common row masks, not variable-specific missingness, claimed.

64 COMPLEX128 selections with strictly positive component variances. Correlations from exact rational pairwise covariance and independently evaluated square roots (80/120 digits); masked/unmasked and dim=1/2 conjugation conventions, unit diagonal and Hermitian structure. Constant-variable and nonfinite cases excluded.

768 exact rational analytic central-power references of orders 2..5 for 64 selections and three complex variables. Independent binomial expansion of raw powers; packed selected-vector and unmasked dimension-1/2 APIs. E((Z-mean)**p) is complex and differs from magnitude moments/variance. User centers, bias corrections and nonfinite cases excluded.

REAL64 pivoted QR: 180 full/reduced factorizations of 30 tall/square/wide shapes with three scaled triangular templates. Pivot permutations, reconstruction of A(:,pivots), orthonormal columns, triangular zeros and preservation; at least one nonidentity pivot required. No fixed phases, prescribed pivot order or rank cutoff claimed.

COMPLEX128 pivoted QR: 180 full/reduced factorizations of 30 tall/square/wide shapes with three scaled triangular templates. Pivot permutations, reconstruction of A(:,pivots), orthonormal columns, triangular zeros and preservation; at least one nonidentity pivot required. No fixed phases, prescribed pivot order or rank cutoff claimed.

45 COMPLEX128 rank-(n-1) overdetermined with nonzero orthogonal residual least-squares problems, built with checked unitary factors and prescribed singular values. Known minimum-norm solution, returned rank, residual, stationarity and null-space orthogonality; cond=1e-12. Near-cutoff or ill-conditioned rank decisions excluded.

Retained failed COMPLEX128 underdetermined LSTSQ consumer at shape 2x4. The API returns invalid problem size before producing numerical results. Exact original and diagnostic probes and full output: docs/gams-candidates/stdlib-underdetermined/README.md. Successful PINV-based solves do not verify this LSTSQ API.

288 COMPLEX128 vector/multiple-RHS solves using explicitly supplied lower/upper Cholesky factors of 72 positive-definite matrices. Sizes 1..8, three patterns/scales; known coefficients, residuals and exact factor/RHS preservation. Factors are manufactured directly; no factorization is performed in these calls. Invalid factors and unused-triangle poisoning excluded.

45 full-row-rank COMPLEX128 underdetermined systems solved using the Moore-Penrose inverse. Checked unitary factors prescribe the unique minimum-norm solution; consistency, stationarity and explicit null-space orthogonality verified, rtol=1e-12. This does not promote the retained failing LSTSQ consumer.

102 REAL64 irregular-grid weight cases; n=0..16, three dyadic spacing patterns and both directions. Exact rational integrals of local Lagrange basis polynomials supply individual weights; polynomial integrals and input preservation checked. Linear exactness checked. Repeated nodes and nonfinite inputs excluded.

306 REAL64 irregular-grid weight cases; n=0..16, three dyadic spacing patterns and both directions. Exact rational integrals of local Lagrange basis polynomials supply individual weights; polynomial integrals and input preservation checked. All even=-1/0/1 modes and omitted default checked; quadratic exactness only when n>=3. Repeated nodes and nonfinite inputs excluded.

108 COMPLEX128 rectangular matrices with entries (3+4i)*integer/8; exact modulus 5*abs(integer)/8 supplies one/infinity/Frobenius references. Rank-three batched dim=[1,2] calls, integer and character orders, zero matrices and input preservation. Spectral norm and extreme-range scaling excluded.

63 COMPLEX128 dense nonnormal matrix eigenproblems of sizes 2..8, three patterns/scales. Explicit invertible shear and checked Householder factors prescribe distinct finite complex spectra. One-to-one eigenvalue matching, normalized left/right eigenvectors, both residual equations and exact input preservation. Eigenvector phases/order unrestricted; defective, clustered and infinite spectra excluded.

63 COMPLEX128 general nonsingular matrix-pair eigenproblems of sizes 2..8, three patterns/scales. Explicit invertible shear and checked Householder factors prescribe distinct finite complex spectra. One-to-one eigenvalue matching, GGEV-scaled left/right eigenvectors, both residual equations and exact input preservation. Eigenvector phases/order unrestricted; defective, clustered and infinite spectra excluded.

3672 integer32 support queries: loc=-8..8, positive scale=1..16, x=loc-2..loc+scale+2. Exact enumeration of inclusive support loc..loc+scale supplies masses and normalization. Integer overload returns default REAL32, so absolute tolerance is 2e-7. Zero/negative scale and overflow excluded.

3672 integer32 support queries: loc=-8..8, positive scale=1..16, x=loc-2..loc+scale+2. Exact enumeration of inclusive support loc..loc+scale supplies cumulative counts and endpoint checks. Integer overload returns default REAL32, so absolute tolerance is 2e-7. Zero/negative scale and overflow excluded.

90 variable-specific REAL64 masked median selections, n=3..12 and three dyadic-data patterns. Python exact rational order statistics, ties and odd/even sample counts; rank-one and rank-two dim=1/2 reductions and ignored-value replacement. Empty masks and nonfinite data excluded.

1080 REAL64 masked moment references: orders 2..5, n=3..12, three patterns, variable-specific masks and default mean/zero/supplied dyadic centers. Exact rational binomial expansion of raw powers; rank-one and dim=1/2 calls. No empty masks, nonfinite or high-order stability claim.

15 three-variable COMPLEX128 datasets with different observation masks per variable; 135 pairwise intersections each containing at least three observations. Exact rational cross-moments and 80/120-digit normalization, population/sample covariance, correlation and transpose conjugacy. Excluded finite sentinels must be ignored. Pairwise deletion is not claimed to preserve positive semidefiniteness; empty/constant pairs excluded.

The main reconstructs a configuration record through current/next, verifies navigation and end boundaries, and checks that peek does not move the cursor. The recovered fields are converted with ordinary internal READ and compared with known values; this is a small parser example, not a full parsing language.

Empty input, Unicode, reverse jumps and negative moves unverified.

projects.description: Partial singular-value decompositions using the historical SciPy PROPACK sources (double precision).

curation.gams_notes: Historical SciPy PROPACK 2.1 sources, whose repository is archived and explicitly points to rmlarsen/propack for the maintained implementation. projects.name: dtfft
projects.description: CPU multidimensional FFTs with MPICH and FFTW; checked single-process round trip.

projects.name: vtmop
projects.description: Derivative-free multiobjective optimization with surrogate models.

curation.gams_notes: Serial derivative-free, bound-constrained multiobjective optimization. An FPM wrapper selects the unchanged solver, surrogate and test-function sources with bundled SLATEC support and links system LP64 BLAS/LAPACK rather than recompiling those bundled libraries. OpenMP linking is enabled, but the checked run uses the serial driver and one execution thread; heap trampolines support internal callbacks in the sandbox. Adapted from the author serial driver and CONVEX function, the seeded 3-variable/2-objective example uses a small evaluation budget, checks feasible design bounds, recomputes both quadratic objectives independently and verifies that no returned point dominates another. It requires multiple distinct trade-off points. This checks the finite returned set, not convergence to the exact global Pareto front or comparative performance. Parallel evaluation, checkpoint recovery, every surrogate and other problem classes are not validated.

Legacy workspace argument type punning uses the package-specific -fallow-argument-mismatch option. The example transforms 96 deterministic scattered points onto a 16-by-18 mode grid for both exponent signs, checking status, finite values and all coefficients against an independent direct sum with the documented 1/nj normalization. Types 2/3, the static Fortran 77 interface, every FFT routine and multidimensional performance are not verified.

projects.name: forlab
projects.description: MATLAB/NumPy-style numerical utilities, linear algebra, interpolation and statistics.

procedures.notes: Rectangular least-squares solve demonstrated by polynomial fitting; square solves have another classification.

96 finite REAL32 data sets n=2..33 and three dyadic affine families. Mean, sample/population variance and standard deviation checked against explicit REAL64 centered sums. Singleton, empty and missing-value conventions excluded.

96 finite REAL32 three-column data sets n=2..33. Sample/population covariance matrices and separate two-vector covariance checked against explicit REAL64 centered cross-products. Other normalization options and missing data excluded.

99 finite REAL32 data sets n=1..33. Median and seven scalar/vector percentiles checked against an independent sorted-data reference using plotting positions (i-1/2)/n and endpoint clamping. Integer percentile API only; other quantile conventions excluded. Built but crashed with SIGSEGV at the first median call for n=1; retained exact probe and output. No median or percentile driver published.

90 nonconstant finite REAL32 data sets n=4..33, three affine families. Population skewness and non-excess kurtosis (flag=1) checked against explicit REAL64 centered third/fourth moments. Bias-adjusted flag=0, constant arrays and missing data are not verified.

189 normal PDF comparisons: mu=-1,0,1; sigma=1/2,1,2; 21 standardized dyadic offsets -5..5. Scalar/vector APIs checked against the independent exponential formula in REAL64. CDFs, tails beyond this range and invalid sigma excluded. Relative tolerance 3e-5 with reference floor 1e-20.

24 strictly positive chi-square inputs for even degrees of freedom 2,4,6,8 and x=1/8,1/2,1,2,4,8. PDF and CDF checked with finite exponential/factorial formulas, not another incomplete-gamma API. Boundary x=0 and odd degrees excluded. Relative tolerance 3e-5 with reference floor 1e-20.

Seven REAL32 SPD matrices n=2..8 constructed from known nonsingular lower-triangular dyadic factors. Returned factor and A=L*transpose(L) reconstruction checked against REAL64 references. Nonpositive-definite inputs excluded.

Seven REAL32 symmetric eigensystems n=2..8 with known Householder-rotated alternating-sign eigenvalues. Dense residuals, orthogonality and order-independent analytic eigenvalues checked; eigenvector signs and ordering are not prescribed.

Five REAL32 tall matrices (m=n+2,n=2..6) from known orthonormal Householder columns and positive distinct singular values. Status, analytic singular-value set, thin-factor orthogonality and reconstruction checked. Wide, rank-deficient and optional-mode state behavior excluded.

Seven nonsymmetric diagonally dominant REAL32 matrices n=2..8, including direct 2x2/3x3 and larger LU paths. Both left/right inverse products checked against identity using the original dense matrix. Singular and ill-conditioned inputs excluded.

48 dyadic uniform-grid cubic samples, lengths 5..20 and h=1/8,1/4,1/2. First, second and third forward difference quotients checked with exact polynomial formulas. Does not verify cumsum (separate retained failed probe), general derivative-error estimation or numerical quadrature.

48 dyadic uniform-grid cubic samples, lengths 5..20 and h=1/8,1/4,1/2. First, second and third forward difference quotients checked with exact polynomial formulas; first-difference cumulative reconstruction checked. Not a general derivative-error estimator or integration quadrature. Combined probe failed cumulative reconstruction: 4.458984375 instead of 4.486328125. cumsum sorts before prefix summation; full probe retained. Not a checked cumsum API.

projects.name: slinked-list
projects.description: Generic singly linked list with reusable storage for small datasets.

curation.gams_notes: Generic singly linked list for small datasets. The main checks integer and real payloads in insertion order, list size, iteration count, emptying, retained capacity and the value stored after reuse; iterator and list cleanup are explicit. A checksum-guarded compatibility edit removes PURE from node_init, whose result has a polymorphic allocatable component. Constructor allocation and copying are unchanged, and the call sites are impure. This patched root retains its own small archive instead of sharing an unmodified graph export. No display dependency is needed for the custom consumer. Large-data performance, all mutation operations and ownership of pointer-containing derived types are not validated.
